items.title: Liverpool preseason schedule, results 2026: Dates, times, more to know about Andoni Iraola plans - sportingnews.com
items.summary: New manager Andoni Iraola will usher the Liverpool squad into the 2026/27 campaign as the Reds ramp up their preseason slate with a tour of the United States. Following in the footsteps of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, also held across North America, Liverpool will visit Nashville, New York City, and Chicago as they look to build fitness and earn minutes ahead of what should be a long and testing season. Some Reds players participated in the World Cup this summer and will need extra time to rest and recover, while others are ready to gear up for the start of the Premier League season. The Sporting News brings you through a look at Liverpool's preseason as they get ready to play their first competitive match on August 23. Liverpool began their preseason slate with a 4-2 victory over Sunderland in Nashville on July 25. Three of Liverpool's five preseason matches will take place in the United States, with games in New York City and Chicago.

Paris Saint-Germain's **Bradley Barcola** has agreed personal terms with Liverpool, while Everton's **Iliman Ndiaye** is being eyed by Manchester United. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe. - Liverpool have reached an agreement in principle over personal terms with Paris Saint-Germain winger **Bradley Barcola**, according to L'Équipe. Barcola is reported to have decided against signing a new contract with the European champions, handing Liverpool encouragement as they look to secure one of their priority signings this summer. The Brighton & Hove Albion forward, who scored 13 goals in the Premier League last term, is set to sign a two-year deal at Stamford Bridge after the two clubs agreed a deal in principle.
